What Trama is

Garment manufacturing software, built for the tablet.

Trama is production control software for apparel factories and contract manufacturers. It records cut orders (list, garment, style, customer, quantity and price), assigns them to your plants based on monthly capacity, tracks each cut through cutting, sewing, pressing, packing, warehouse and shipping, and flags urgent deliveries. The iPad and Android app works offline; the web version brings Trama to any office computer.

Offline

Your plant's Wi-Fi doesn't decide when you work.

With the app, your data lives on the iPad or Android tablet, in a local database. No servers going down, no loading screens, no hunting for signal on the shop floor.

  • On-device databaseCut orders, reports, catalogs and images are stored on the tablet.
  • Offline sign-inPasswords are hashed (PBKDF2) on the device itself.
  • Backup and syncAutomatic backup, and everything syncs as soon as the connection is back.
  • Migration from your current systemWe import your plants, customers, styles and cut orders during setup.

App vs Web

Web for the office, app for the floor.

The native iPad and Android app keeps working even when there's no signal on the shop floor. The web version puts Trama on any computer, with nothing to install. Plant, Multi-plant and Enterprise include both.

FAQ

Questions we often get.

How much does Trama cost?

Web is $49 per month, Plant $99, Multi-plant $249 and Enterprise starts at $590, plus taxes. Pay yearly and you get 2 months free. Pricing is per company, not per user.

What's the difference between the app and the web version?

The iPad and Android app keeps your data on the device, so it works offline, it's faster and it uses the camera for style photos. The web version needs no installation and runs on any computer, but it requires a connection. Plant, Multi-plant and Enterprise include both.

Can I download Trama from the App Store or Google Play?

No. The apps are distributed privately to licensed companies, so you control which devices have them and nobody outside your company can install them. The web version is accessed with a username and password.

Do I need internet to use it?

Not with the app: sign-in, cut orders, reports, catalogs and charts all work offline, and everything syncs when the connection comes back. The web version does need a connection.

Does it work on Android?

Yes. There's a native app for Android 8.0+ tablets and phones, with the same rules and the same backup format as the iPad app.

Where is my data stored?

With the app, in a local database on each device, with automatic backup. You can also export full backups at any time and restore them on another iPad or Android device.

Can you migrate data from my current system?

Yes. Migration is included in Multi-plant and Enterprise: we import plants, customers, suppliers, styles, cut orders and reports. We review your case during the demo.

What is garment manufacturing software?

It's a system to plan and track apparel production: which cut orders exist, which plant is making them, how far along each one is and when it ships. Trama does it on a tablet, offline, with a role for each manager.

Does it work for contract manufacturers?

Yes. Trama was born at a multi-plant contract manufacturer: it assigns cut orders based on each plant's monthly capacity, logs daily production and prioritizes urgent shipments by the customer's delivery date.
